entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Wasm RyuJIT] R2R #121257
  • On macOS, an application that calls CreateDefaultBuilder() starts a FileSystemWatcher on the system root directory #121256
  • [.NET Core/Linux] X509 chain revocation check uses only first CDP URL, does not fall back to others #121253
    10.0.x
  • `InterfaceSupportsErrorInfo` called with CLSID instead of an IID #121252
    11.0.0
  • stackalloc long[3] is slower than [0,0,0] #121248
  • Add __ImageBase external varibable in C# code As Intristic #121229

Closed

  • [naot][android] System.Diagnostics.Debug.Tests failures #121255
  • [naot][android] GetHashCode_MultipleSubClasses_ShouldBeUnique test failure #121254
  • Developers using the Mono embedding API can upgrade to modern .NET #47763
  • [API Proposal]: Remove ILoggerFactory.AddProvider() #121250
  • System.Runtime.Intrinsics docs for .NET 10.0 APIs #120508
    10.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: Gusid - Globally Unique Sequential Identifier #121244
  • [clr-ios] Generate runtime packs for Apple mobile RIDs #120050
    11.0.0
  • CborWriter.Reset incorrectly resets `_definiteLength` #121182
  • CborWriter.Reset does not clear _currentIndefiniteLengthStringRanges #121183
  • [WASM] string Normalize() / IsNormalized() compatibility forms #117116
    11.0.0
  • [wasm] VFS/common WasmApp properties ignored in wasmbrowser template #99223
    Future
  • Metadata difference between platform-specific executable ("apphost") and the portable DLL #121227
  • [Net10] Unrecognized instruction set popcnt in BenchmarkDotNet #121228

PullRequests

Created

  • Refactor `GenTreeJitIntrinsic` to store the base type for SIMD operations as a `var_types`. #121251
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix binding IEnumerable<T> with empty array configuration #121249
    area-Extensions-Configuration, 11.0.0
  • [mono][sgen] Make color visible to client permanent #121247
    area-GC-mono
  • [Draft] Upstream/ce/right shift cast test #121246
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [mono][sgen] Add option to disable tarjan gc bridge optimization #121243
    area-GC-mono
  • Map Apple mobile targets to OSX in PerfMapWriter to support Crossgen2 compilation #121237
    area-crossgen2-coreclr, os-ios, 11.0.0
  • Remove more unsafe code from IPAddress parsing #121225
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe
  • [SRM] Deduplicate and optimize `BlobWriterImpl.WriteConstant`. #121223
    area-System.Reflection.Metadata, community-contribution

Merged

  • Delete unused method from runtime async #121245
    area-VM-coreclr
  • [RuntimeAsync] Remove no longer needed workarounds for Roslyn NYIs #120895
    test-enhancement, area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Implement CEE_JMP for the interpreter #121130
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Disable part of nopiatest on interpreter #121147
    needs-area-label
  • Improve the docs for ObjectiveCMarshal.CreateReferenceTrackingHandle slightly. #121232
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices
  • Add `runtime-report-green` pipeline to Build Analysis #121230
    documentation, area-Infrastructure
  • Delete IA64-specific comment and associated code #121226
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Fix some System.Formats.Asn1 documentation mistakes #121179
    area-System.Formats.Asn1
  • Fix CborWriter.Reset. #121188
    area-System.Formats.Cbor
